title: calystegia macrostegia
intro: Calystegia macrostegia, commonly known as Island Morning Glory, is a perennial vine native to California and the Channel Islands. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional herbal medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Calystegia macrostegia include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve heart health, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular-protective effects.
